hut.subtitle: A hut in the woods
hut.intro: Smoke curls from a hut half swallowed by the trees. Inside, by a small fire, sits a very old man.
hut.story: "I was a planeswalker once, from a world far from this one," he says. "There I sat before a glowing window and played at Shandalar, a game of wizards and cards. One night the game played me instead. It drew me through, and here I have stayed ever since."
hut.peace: "I am done with duels and wizards' wars. I want only peace now, and a warm fire."
hut.offer: "But I still know things nobody else in Shandalar knows. For 1000 gold I will tell you where a dungeon lies that no wise man has ever heard of."
hut.told: He counts the gold, then draws a map in the ashes of the hearth. "{dungeon}. I found it long ago, in my old world, when this was only a game. Mind its guardians. The cards I left there are yours, if you can take them."
hut.marked: The way to {dungeon} is marked on your map.
hut.waiting: The old man looks up from the fire. "You know the way to {dungeon}. Go, before its guardians grow bolder."
hut.cleared: "So you found my old treasures," the old man smiles. "Keep them well. I have nothing left to sell, only peace, and that I keep for myself."
hut.clue: The old man in the woods told you where {dungeon} lies.
hut.log: Paid the old man in the woods 1000 gold for the way to {dungeon}.
